incentives.offerText: Flex Cash up to $40,000 (per community maximum stated in offer footnote; applies only to previously constructed inventory homes)
incentives.deadline: Contract must be signed October 1-31, 2026; settlement must be completed by December 31, 2026.
incentives.notes: Main banner advertises 'Up to $20,000 in Flex Cash' site-wide, but a footnote table sets a different, community-specific maximum (used here); banner and footnote figures conflict. Cannot be combined with other offers; non-transferable; not redeemable for cash; inventory homes only.
